# Main executable dependency and selector-candidate comparison

**Source:** `reports/metadata/host-executable-selector-inventory.md` and its JSON companion, generated by successful GitHub Actions run 43550711465.

## Host executable comparison

| Property | Lara v0.2 | DSGames 2.5 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Main executable | `lara` | `DSGames` |
| Minimum iOS | 16.0.0 | 16.1.0 |
| SDK | 26.2.0 | 26.5.0 |
| Declared run paths | 2 | 2 |
| Linked dylib entries | 44 | 46 |
| Distinct method-name string candidates extracted | 346 | 2,235 |

Both executables declare the same two run-path entries and link the two corresponding bundled libraries using matching install-name forms. There are 37 exact linked-dylib-name matches out of the inventories; Lara has 7 names not listed by DSGames, and DSGames has 9 names not listed by Lara.

The string-section comparison found 293 exact string-name overlaps, 53 Lara-only candidates, and 1,942 DSGames-only candidates. These counts are **candidate string matches**, not verified Objective-C method implementations or ABI matches. The extractor reads printable C strings from the Objective-C method-name section; it does not prove that a selector is referenced by a live call site, implemented by a particular class, or callable in the other app.

## Compatibility interpretation

1. **Host loader layout:** the apps have matching run-path declarations and both refer to the same two embedded library install-name forms. This is useful loader evidence, but it does not establish that the libraries are interchangeable.
2. **Platform baseline:** Lara's host executable declares iOS 16.0 while DSGames declares iOS 16.1. Any integration must be built and tested against Lara's declared support floor, and any dependency requiring a newer OS must be excluded or availability-guarded.
3. **Linked frameworks:** 37 exact dependency-name matches are present. The remaining differences must be reviewed against actual use before adding/removing any framework.
4. **Objective-C names:** overlap in selector-name strings is a discovery aid only. Class ownership, method type encodings, implementation addresses, call sites, object lifetime, and semantic behavior remain unverified.

## Build status and next gate

The static analysis workflow completed successfully. The repository currently contains IPA inputs, scripts, and reports, but no application source tree, Xcode project, or reproducible app build configuration. Therefore no new installable Lara IPA can be built from this repository as it stands.

**Release gate:** obtain the matching Lara source project and build settings, preserve the baseline, and only then run a normal signed app build plus unit and owned-app integration tests. Do not transplant or invoke undocumented interfaces based only on these static matches.
